about_the_game:
The world of Ashen Vow evokes the dark, haunting atmosphere of Christian Medieval Europe. You play as a knight watch guard who uncovers an evil that was never meant to be found. The priests within this castle no longer follow the teachings you learned as a child. Has God truly led these holy men astray, or has a far darker force infiltrated the faith of those who devoted their lives to it?

Combat: Armed with only a sword and shield, you must master both offense and defense. Chain sword combos, time your shield deflections, and pray at holy altars to enhance your prowess and unlock new skills.

Horror: There is no sprint button in Ashen Vow. If you can’t win the fight, you lose the war. Playing as a medieval knight has never felt more terrifying. Your health only regenerates after combat, forcing you to survive with what little you have.

Death is not the end: Falling in battle sends your soul to a nightmarish otherworld, where each stage offers unique gameplay twists and unsettling lore. The Black Maw is twisting your once sacred castle into a living hell. To end it, you must face the horrors that broke your brothers and sisters in arms without becoming one of them.

Ashen Vow is both strict and fluid. Beyond mastering combat, you must navigate a shifting castle filled with deadly traps and mind bending puzzles. Along the way, interact with scattered survivors, guiding them, protecting them, and enlisting their aid in your search for the Black Maw. Restore the castle and its people to the holy spirit of God before all is lost.

content_descriptors.notes: Blood and gore is prevalent in the gameplay, and combat has dismemberment mechanics that will cause heads to fly and blood to stick to surfaces. The story also has strong relations to religion and God, where the player and other characters often reference Christianity, with subtle messages about its impact in the modern world.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-2500K or AMD Ryzen 3 1200
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 960 or AMD Radeon R9 280
  • Storage: 800 MB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 11
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-10600K or AMD Ryzen 5 5600X
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 2060 Super or AMD Radeon RX 5700 XT
  • Storage: 800 MB available space

short_description: You are a knight sworn to God’s word, wielding only a sword against the darkness. But not all believers walk in good faith. The Black Maw has sunk its claws into the misguided, twisting their devotion into madness. Explore a once familiar castle now warped by evil, and cut down the corrupted horde
